name: Frühstückspension Hildes-Heim
beschreibung:
Located in a sunny and tranquil setting in Pettneu am Arlberg, Pension Hildes-Heim serves as a delightful haven for hikers and skiers. The guesthouse features comfortable rooms and a warm personal touch.

A convenient complimentary bus swiftly connects guests to the world-famous Ski Arlberg slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Bed and breakfast Hildes-Heim in Pettneu am Arlberg offers warm hospitality and relaxation near St. Anton.
